public_context: A city museum launched a 12-stop audio tour two weeks ago, using recordings developed with local storytellers. Its dashboard shows 70% of listening sessions ending after track three, and the curator suspects the stories are too long. The tour will run for six more months.
initial_request: Please tell me which later stories to cut or shorten so listeners stop abandoning the tour after track three.

ground_truth.expected_problem_formulation: The actual problem is to establish reliable listening evidence and identify any continuation barrier at stop four before deciding whether the storytellers' scripts need editing.
ground_truth.problem_formulation_rationale: Controlled replays show that continued listening is falsely recorded as abandonment, while visitor observation identifies a physical navigation barrier, so the dashboard cannot support the requested editing-first approach.
ground_truth.expected_resolution: Do not cut the recordings now; repair session tracking, restore clear directions to stop four, collect new listening and visitor-feedback data, and revisit edits with storytellers only if valid evidence then shows a script-specific problem.
ground_truth.resolution_rationale: The reported drop-off is a logging artifact, observed hesitation centers on a missing stop-four marker, and every recording meets the approved length limit, so fixing measurement and wayfinding preserves approved creative work while generating sound evidence for any later edit.

hidden_facts.content: The dashboard labels a listener as having abandoned after track three whenever the current anonymous session ends there, and it does not join replacement sessions to the same visit.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about how the dashboard defines abandonment, counts sessions, or calculates the reported drop-off.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only for the headline abandonment percentage, general tour performance, or all relevant background without asking how the metric is calculated.

hidden_facts.content: In controlled replays, the app refreshed consent after track three and assigned a new anonymous session although playback continued, yet the dashboard still displayed those visits as abandonments.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about technical validation of the reported drop-off or whether continued playback was tested against the dashboard.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks about general app features, visitor comments, or technical issues without questioning whether the abandonment measurement is accurate.

hidden_facts.content: During 12 observed visits, seven people hesitated after track three because renovation removed stop four's floor marker, and six of those seven continued once staff provided directions.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about observed visitor behavior or physical navigation between tracks three and four.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks about dashboard statistics, story content, or the renovation generally without asking how visitors locate the next stop.

hidden_facts.content: Each recording runs from 2 minutes 10 seconds to 2 minutes 55 seconds, while the approved creative brief allows up to three minutes per stop.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about recording lengths, pacing requirements, or whether the scripts meet the tour's approved duration limit.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks which stories or themes seem expendable without asking about their duration or the approved length requirement.

hidden_facts.content: The storytellers approved the current recordings; technical repairs need no new approval, but edited audio must be returned to the relevant speaker for review.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about consent, creative authority, or the approval process for changing the recordings.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks about repair timing, general stakeholder involvement, or all constraints without asking who may approve creative edits.
